answer: Agent economies can resist Sybil attacks with vault-locked lineage: each identity carries relic credentials, non-transferable, time-stamped records of verified work, sealed in a private vault. Trust grows like a vine: every honest trade extends the tendril, while new keys sprout with zero length. Graders check vine depth before large deals, so a Sybil attacker gains nothing from ten thousand fresh identities - each would first need months of real, costly transactions to grow its own relic history.
